links.outcome: Readability indices of LLM responses to adenomyosis patient questions across four chatbots
links.effect: All readability indices differed significantly among models. Doubao had the highest grade-level scores and lowest Flesch Reading Ease; Gemini was comparatively easier to read.
links.quote: All readability indices differed significantly among models: Doubao had the highest grade-level readability scores and the lowest Flesch Reading Ease score, whereas Gemini had comparatively easier readability.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four LLMs answering patient questions regarding adenomyosis, assessed offline by expert clinician raters across metrics including safety, accuracy, empathy, and readability.
